title: NoPearlStasis
description: Prevent ender pearls from being in stasis.
body:
# NoPearlStasis
A plugin to prevent ender pearl stasis chambers.

Ender pearls in stasis teleport the player immediately.

- Affects all stasis chamber setups from bubble columns, honey blocks, slime blocks, and pistons.

- Does not interfere with pearls in normal water, trident pearls, etc.
